dogecoin.text:
I've never owned a single dollar's worth of $DOGE.

I did, however, own $100 of $PIG at one time, which became $50000 yesterday, and dropped to $16000 today. It'll go back up.

I will never #acceptdoge because it is a distraction away from Bitcoin and other decentralized means that would give us financial freedom. Dogecoin isn't a true decentralized coin. There isn't even a limit to how many coins can be minted, so it's essentially the same as the fiat.
@elonmusk $GDOGE does exactly what you want $DOGE to do, Elon!

I still have zero DOGE, and see no good reason to invest in it.

Why should I invest in Dogecoin? Give me one good reason.
